profile.summary: Paul Merchants Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in India. It operates through Forex, Travel, and Other segments. The company offers foreign exchange services in the form of currency notes, traveler cheques, travel cards, outward remittance, and foreign currency drafts; tour and travel services, including air ticketing, hotel accommodation, bus and cruise tours,
